result.one_liner: API-first customer support platform for technical teams with GraphQL API and native MCP server.

evidence.quote: Foundation at $39/month for one seat, Expansion at $299/month for three seats, and Frontier at $1,055/month for six seats
Plain provides a public GraphQL API with no rate limits — the same endpoints the product UI uses internally
only one has native MCP server support — Plain is that platform

result.notes: Plain requires paid subscription to access the API. API keys are generated per workspace with fine-grained permissions. GraphQL is the primary API offering. Verdict is yellow because API access is gated behind paid tiers but otherwise has standard self-serve credential setup within paid workspaces.
